Castell Fasteners' site traffic drop is a real warning sign, not normal B2B seasonality: it's down 10.6% year-over-year while 4 of its 5 B2B peers grew 11-86% over the same period.

Good news on churn: no established merchant (20+ lifetime orders) has gone silent for 180+ days - the only 9 merchants who've actually churned were all small, low-volume accounts that never gained traction.

Two popular 'early warning' theories for shopper churn didn't hold up: email open rates are nearly identical for shoppers about to go quiet vs. staying active (36% either way), and refunds process in under a day for virtually everyone, so there's no 'slow refund' group to test against satisfaction.
